name: Native Steam Keyboard Enhancement
summary: Improves Valve's own on-screen keyboard in KDE Desktop Mode at runtime (no Steam files are patched): flush bottom/top placement with a move key, a real Hide key, transparency, Ctrl/Alt keys, long-press symbols, reliable English/Russian typing in Chrome, genuine Tab/Shift+Tab, Backspace word-delete, keyboard above Plasma popups, and Legion Go sticks/triggers/touchpad/D-pad while the keyboard is open.
restart: Restart Steam once if the installer enabled Steam's local debugger; otherwise the keyboard is enhanced the next time it opens.
